source.section: Schedule M line 33(a)-(b) Other Retirement Modification, 'Combined amounts of 33a and 33b must not exceed $2,000' (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22); Schedule M line 47 Senior Citizen Deduction columns (a)-(d) (PDF p.6; instructions PDF p.29; example PDF p.30; PDF p.23 'Taxpayers over age 65 or disabled'; Tax Division page: 'You receive the higher of the $8,000 modification or the sum of various itemized decreasing modifications'); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 66, a New York State public pension of 40,000 only: no pension line takes it, but line 47 takes any income, so the 8,000 reaches it. filer born 1959-06-30, age 66 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = New York State pension 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 40,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 aged 65 or older = 22,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 40,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: New York State pension 40,000.00: no Schedule M line names another state's pension, so none is subtracted (wv_other_retirement 0.00); line 47 (age 66): column (c) income not on lines 35-46 = 40,000.00, limited to 8,000.00: 8,000.00; column (d) lines 29-34 = 0.00; line 47 = 8,000.00 - 0.00 = 8,000.00; line 49 = 8,000.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 8,000.00. Projection (per person): The filer: Social Security subtraction 0.00; age 65 deduction = lesser of (8,000.00 - military retirement 0.00) and own income 40,000.00 = 8,000.00; best_of_group wv_line_47 keeps the larger, 8,000.00 (wv_senior_citizen_deduction). Projection subtractions total 8,000.00, the same as line 50. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 8,000.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 40,000.00 + 0.00 - 8,000.00 = 32,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 32,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 30,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 5,000.00 = 166.5; total 832.5 = 832.50. The Tax Table row 29,980 to under 30,040 (PDF p.38 on) gives 833; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 832.50.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
